Subject: Selwyn Residential - Referral Questions

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the Selwyn Residential submission. I've reviewed the information and have a few questions before I can move forward.

This account requires referral approval due to:
- Louisiana location (outside our standard appetite)
- Five-year loss history exceeding $250K

To present this to our referral team, I'll need:
- What loss control measures have been implemented since the major losses?
- Any property improvements or risk mitigation completed in the past two years?
- Details on the circumstances of the largest losses

If this doesn't fit your timeline, I'd recommend reaching out to a surplus lines market specializing in Louisiana habitational risks—they may be better positioned to quote competitively.

Happy to discuss further if you'd like.

Best,
[Underwriter name]
